<subject>Re: message from Nordheim</subject>
<body>
will do! All procurement lists are currently under review. Will you share your list as well?

I decided to wait until the company holiday party to give you G's photo - is that okay with you? I CAN send it earlier if you prefer. Her school photos arrived as well.

Sorry I didn't call back last night. We were reviewing grid equipment orders with Hans-Uwe Ditschlerin and then it was time for dinner, etc., etc. and got a call from Mema where she immediately started talking about her health issues. Was Günter Zimmer's report satisfactory to you?
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: elwira.plath@nordwind-energie.de
Sent: Monday, 10 November 2025 14:02
To: Anke Anders
Subject: message from Nordheim


Nordheim is going on a trip to Windstadt right before Christmas and would like to finish scheduling, er, making arrangements prior to the trip...not to mention Nordheim has a very busy event schedule once December starts... wish lists for you, Gottfried and P-nut would be much appreciated!
</quoted>
